entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Bump emsdk to >= 6.0.10 to pick up memory.copy-based memmove (overlapping Span.CopyTo is 4-5x slower on CoreCLR wasm) #136012
    12.0.0
  • Helper-based tail call with a Span<double> argument corrupts memory (Windows x64, Debug/MinOpts) #136010
  • An AssemblyLoadContext whose ToString() returns null crashes the process on a cross-context InvalidCastException or under binder tracing #136008
  • [NativeAOT][macOS x64] .NET 11 RC2 publish fails with unaligned GSS descriptor in libSystem.Net.Security.Native.a #136007
  • [RuntimeAsync] Intermittent GC crash in standalone safe C# repro on .NET 11 RC2 (Windows x64, Debug) #136004
  • Generic virtual method call never returns after a collectible AssemblyLoadContext is collected and the same assembly is loaded again (.NET 10 regression) #136003
  • RuntimeAsync: a byref-like struct local holding object references is stored into the continuation without a GC write barrier #136000
  • Disposing SocketsHttpHandler leaks HTTP/2 connections (socket, SslStream, native TLS state) when PooledConnectionLifetime is TimeSpan.Zero #135997
  • Socket.Poll(SelectError) does not report out-of-band data on macOS, iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst #135995

Closed

  • [ci-scan] Test failure: SocketsHttpHandler_HttpClientHandler_ServerCertificates_Test bad-certificate cases on Android CoreCLR #135988
  • Test failure: ServerCertificates_Test.UseCallback_BadCertificate_ExpectedPolicyErrors on linux-x64 and linux_musl-x64 #135998
  • The request was canceled due to the configured HttpClient.Timeout of 100 seconds elapsing #123572
    Future
  • JIT (x64, .NET 10): Vector128.CreateScalar(x).As<double, ulong>().ToScalar() returns garbage (backport of #129644?) #135923
  • [wasi][R2R] BFloat16 conversions from Int128/UInt128 produce wrong values #135116
    12.0.0
  • Debugger func-eval: a by-value `ref struct` with overlapping `ref` fields is reported to the GC twice, so a compacting GC relocates the byref twice #135245
  • Test failure: System.Net.Quic.Tests.MsQuicTests.QuicRootedObjectGetReleased #134828
    Future
  • MutexTests failing on Unix, browser and WASI after #135778 (default named-mutex scope change) #135887

    area-Tools-ILVerification, community-contribution
